steps.done_when: raw cracked eggs with yolks visible sit in the bowl and empty shells are set aside on paper towel

steps.do: Destem {herb_bunch} fresh herbs and finely chop the leaves on the cutting board
steps.done_when: small pile of finely chopped green herb leaves sits on the cutting board with bare stems separated to the side

steps.do: Wash, dry and slice {tomato_count} tomato into halves on the cutting board
steps.done_when: tomato cut into two halves lies on the cutting board with stem removed

steps.do: Add the chopped herbs to the bowl with the eggs and season with {salt} salt and {pepper} pepper
steps.done_when: bowl contains cracked eggs topped with a mound of chopped green herbs and visible seasoning

steps.do: Whisk the egg and herb mixture with a fork until evenly blended
steps.done_when: egg and herbs are blended into a uniform yellow-green liquid in the bowl with no streaks of yolk

steps.do: Scrub the frying pan clean, dry it, place on the burner and add {oil_amount} cooking oil to coat
steps.done_when: clean frying pan sits on the burner with a thin even layer of oil coating the bottom

steps.do: Place the tomato halves cut-side down in the hot oiled pan and fry briefly
steps.done_when: two tomato halves rest cut-side down in the frying pan on the stove

steps.do: Pour the whisked egg and herb mixture into the pan around the tomatoes and cook while stirring until set
steps.done_when: egg is set opaque and lightly browned around the tomatoes with green herbs distributed throughout the pan

steps.do: Transfer the cooked egg and tomatoes from the pan to the plate
steps.done_when: cooked green egg and two tomato halves sit together on the plate with the pan empty
